subject: Discovery recap: slabbed consumption bands & invoice calculator
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Amira Hassan <amira@sigmax.com>, Procurement <procurement@sigmax.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-25T14:03:00-07:00
Subject: Discovery recap: slabbed consumption bands & invoice calculator

Hi Amira — thanks again for the call earlier today. Quick recap and next steps so we have alignment on assumptions before I turn this into a formal quote. I attached a slabbed pricing calculator and a short pilot playbook for reference.

Key assumptions we used in the attached calc (slabbed-pricing-calculator_v1.xlsx):
- Average tokens per request: 600 tokens (prompt+response)
- Peak concurrency we modeled: 35 qps (burst-safe)
- Pilot duration for the estimate: 90 days
- KV/prefix caching: assumed 18% per-token reduction for repeated prompts

Consumption bands (monthly tokens) we sketched:
1) Light pilot: 25–75M tokens/mo — target $/1M = $450–$550
2) Mid pilot: 150–250M tokens/mo — target $/1M = $300–$380
3) Scale band: 500M+ tokens/mo — target $/1M = $180–$240

Notes on structure:
- The attached sheet has two tabs: "Runway" (monthly burn by band) and "Invoice Sketch" (line-item cost including serving + storage + tracing).
- We included an optional committed discount tier (6-month term) and a non-committed on-demand path. The committed band assumes a 10% reducer on unit rates at volumes >=100M/mo.

Requests / next steps:
- Can you confirm which consumption band you want the formal pilot quote to target (Light / Mid / Scale)?
- If the Mid band looks right, do you prefer committed pricing (6 months / minimum 100M/mo) or non-committed month-to-month?
- Procurement: please share the contact and any PO / billing constraints so we can prepare terms (net30, SOW, tax details).
- If helpful, I can carve a short invoice CSV (preview) showing month-by-month totals — I included an example in the attachments.

I can jump on a 20-min sync tomorrow to walk the calc if you want.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0193
Redwood Inference

Attachments: slabbed-pricing-calculator_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet), pilot-consumption-playbook.pdf (doc)

On Wed, Aug 25, 2027 at 2:03 PM Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com> wrote:
> Hi Amira — thanks again for the call earlier today. Quick recap and next steps so we have alignment on assumptions before I turn this into a formal quote. I attached a slabbed pricing calculator and a short pilot playbook for reference.

Thanks Kim — this is very helpful. High level from our side: the Mid pilot band (150–250M tokens/mo) looks closest to our expected run rate during the 90-day pilot. Our finance lead asked whether you can provide: 1) a committed pricing option with a cap (we'd consider a 6-month minimum commitment), and 2) a month-to-month option with an overage cap or alerting to avoid surprises.

A couple of clarifying Qs before I ask Procurement to start the PO path:
- Can you confirm the $/1M range in the Mid band if we do a 6-month commitment vs month-to-month?
- What is the billing cadence (monthly in arrears?) and will the invoice show token line items vs aggregated charges?

If you can send a short invoice preview (month 1/2/3) and a simple committed vs on-demand comparison, Procurement will be able to advise quickly. I can loop in our legal after Procurement confirms the budget path.

- Amira
Director of Product, SigmaX Systems
amira@sigmax.com

Subject: Re: Discovery recap: slabbed consumption bands & invoice calculator

Amira — thanks, this is great context. Short answers and an updated attachment: I added a one-page invoice preview (pilot-invoice-estimate.csv) and updated the calculator with a committed vs on-demand comparison. The file is attached and I've also dropped the Drive link below.

Committed (6mo, min 100M/mo) vs On-demand (month-to-month) for the Mid band we discussed:
- On-demand: $/1M = $340 (midpoint of the previously shared range) — no minimum, standard rate card
- Committed 6mo, min 100M/mo: $/1M = $306 (10% discount applied at 100M+ threshold)

Billing cadence and invoice detail:
- Monthly in arrears; invoices break out: tokens (by model family), serving/runtime surcharge, storage & tracing, and any one-time setup credits. The CSV shows a month-by-month sample for a 90-day pilot at 200M tokens/mo.
- We can include an alerts policy for projected overages; Procurement can opt into calendar reminders or daily token dashboards.

Attachments: pilot-invoice-estimate.csv (CSV preview), updated slabbed-pricing-calculator_v1.xlsx (revised tabs). Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2B3Calc

If the committed path looks reasonable, confirm and we'll prepare a formal quote and PO-ready doc (HS-REC-6821). If you prefer on-demand, we'll generate a non-binding invoice preview and set up the monitoring alerts.

Thanks — I can have a formal quote to you within 48 business hours once you confirm the band and commitment.

Best,
Kimberly
kimberly_park@redwood.com

Attachments: pilot-invoice-estimate.csv (csv), slabbed-pricing-calculator_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet)
